import type { OrbVariant } from "@/components/orbs/canvas";

  slug: "orb-18",
  title: "ORB-18",
} as const;

export const orb18Orb: OrbVariant = {
  colors: [{ default: "#ffffff", key: "tint", label: "Tint" }],
  key: meta.slug,
  label: meta.title,
